verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents a RESTful API that covers "much of the data in the system", with examples such as listing and filtering items, and token management via both UI and API. That wording concedes coverage short of full UI parity. No OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path, which makes parity hard to verify. missing for 10: evidence that every UI action (merging, custom fingerprinting, notification/integration setup, status and owner changes) is exposed via API, a published OpenAPI spec, independent confirmation of API completeness.
